_about: Hosts cloud sessions keep needing, probed in parallel by platform/ci/egress_probe.py. Egress is a per-environment allow-list, so reachability is measured each run, never stored here. 'fallback' names a route another session verified when the host itself was refused; 'source' is where that was recorded. Add a host when you probe it by hand; add a fallback only after fetching through it.
